savedquery.name: Eligible for Current Round
savedquery.description: Applications the process owner has opened for a trustee review round (rev_eligibleforround = true, TAD section 3.1, FR-038) - the admin-side counterpart of what WBS 6.2/6.3's Trustee Review Portal reads. Shows rev_reviewround so staff can see which round each row is scoped to, and rev_redactionreleased so staff can see the second half of the visibility gate (TAD section 5.5: a trustee needs BOTH rev_eligibleforround = true AND rev_redactionreleased = true). rev_redactionreleased is written only by REV | Narrative | Scrub Free-Text (WBS 5.2/5.3), which is deferred (EX-003) - every row here will show it unset until that automation lands, which is the fail-closed default working as designed, not a defect in this view.
